name: done-then
description: Observe one or more Codex tasks for a fail-closed future shutdown handoff.

interface.longDescription: Observe a time-limited single-session or multi-session Stop grant without treating Stop as task success. Dry-run is available now; real Stop-based execute remains disabled until trusted final Hook arbitration and recovery evidence are delivered.
defaultPrompt: Dry-run Done Then for this turn and report the observed Stop state without taking a power action.
